entities.name: Ribosome-recycling factor
observations: The 187-residue query sequence exactly matches curated UniProt protein Q1WUG4 from Ligilactobacillus salivarius.
Homologs in Enterococcus faecalis and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum show 69.0–69.6% identity over approximately the full sequence.
The protein contains Pfam RRF domain PF01765.25 at positions 22–185.
Curated function: releases ribosomes from messenger RNA after translation termination and promotes ribosome reuse.
Curated localization: cytoplasm; curated GO terms include ribosomal large subunit binding and translational termination.
